name: Amalgum
source:
Time is almost up! A young witch named Patelle Rose and her fairy assistant, Florion, are scrambling to finish making Halloween candy for the town's annual candy-making competition.  Join Patelle as she converses with a colorful cast of characters and begins to learn the dark secret behind the very competition she's eager to win.

[From [url=https://two-o.itch.io/amalgum]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间快到了！一位名叫帕特尔·罗斯的年轻女巫和她的仙女助手弗洛里恩正忙着为镇上一年一度的糖果制作比赛制作万圣节糖果。与Patelle一起与色彩缤纷的人物交谈，并开始了解她渴望获胜的比赛背后的黑暗秘密。

[来自[url=https://two-o.itch.io/amalgum]itch.io[/url]]
